note: Two public wallets, each verified to be the OWNER of the token balances that move, not merely an address the transaction touches. That check is the point: Helius's /addresses/{x}/transactions returns everything involving x, so a pool or routing account looks like a busy trader and decodes to 0 swaps. The wallets are measured for decoding only. No balance, position or profit is reported for either, here or downstream.
selectionTest: owner of the token balances in 6 of 6 sampled swaps, and 50 of 50 for the second

rejected.why: Never appears as the owner of any token balance in its own transactions. The enhanced API lists 21 swaps per 100 transactions for it, and the decoder correctly returns not-a-swap on all 42 sampled, because no balance of that wallet changed. It is a participant address, not a trader.
